summary: South Plains Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Board Representation Agreement with shareholder Henry TAW LP, effective June 17, 2026. The agreement had granted the shareholder the right to designate one board nominee. At origination in 2019, the shareholder held about 16% of outstanding shares; its stake has since fallen below 10%. The board believes termination aligns with the company's maturation as a widely-held public entity. Richard D. Campbell, the designated representative, will remain on the board through his current term and is expected to be renominated. This is a governance change, not a special situation event.
